# Solving the Problem Using a Nonlinear Approach

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Solving the Problem Using a Nonlinear Approach

In a nonlinear approach, an element can have a number of predecessors and successors.

![Multiple Paths in Nonlinear](data:image/png;base64,)

We can see that there are multiple ways to travel from A to F.

Following a non-linear approach, we first list out all the possible paths and choose the best one.

| Path | Route | Total Distance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Path 1 | A -> B -> C -> D -> E -> F | 13 km |
| Path 2 | A -> B-> E -> F | 10 km |

Since Path 2 provides the shortest path from A to F, we choose Path 2.
